headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for sizes > 32px. Use font-black for impact and font-light for elegance. Do not center-align by default.

body.rules: High legibility for data density. Use leading-relaxed for paragraphs.

hierarchy.H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-slate-900
hierarchy.H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-800

primary.description: Vibrant Cobalt Blue. Represents cool air, reliability, and corporate trust.

secondary.description: Ice Grey / Off-white for section backgrounds to avoid harsh contrast.

accent.description: Arctic Cyan for hover states and secondary highlights.

destructive.description: Signal Red for errors, rejected verifications, or urgent maintenance.

warning.description: Energy Yellow for pending status, schedules, or warnings.

marketing_landing_page.rules: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8. Mix spans (e.g., Hero col-span-8 row-span-2). No standard Bootstrap columns. Never center-everything.

admin_dashboard.rules: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Sharp edges or max 8px border-radius. Cardless flat rectangles preferred. F-pattern hierarchy.

technician_mobile.rules: Scannable lists with large touch targets (min-h-[48px]). Prominent 'Next Action' buttons at the bottom. Generous padding (p-4 to p-6).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows. Never use muddy gray. Use shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,71,171,0.08)] for hovering primary cards.

components_instructions.general: Do NOT use HTML elements for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn components and customize their styles.
components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangles (rounded-md) depending on context. MUST have hover transitions (transform & bg color). NEVER use transition-all. Use transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Multi-step rental form must have clear progress indicators. Do not use native input type='date', use Shadcn Calendar.
components_instructions.tables: Admin dashboard lists must use Shadcn tables with dense padding and clear hover states.
components_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications (success, error, status updates). Path: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background hue and slightly translate (e.g., -translate-y-0.5) on hover.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered entrance animations for dashboard lists (Framer Motion).
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add aria-hidden='true' to decorative animations.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-rental-form').
accessibility.contrast: Text over images must use bg-black/40 overlay or text-shadow. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or headers.

icons.instruction: Use Lucide React (default installed). For mobile technician app, use stroke-width 2 for clarity.

images.description: White AC unit on a brick wall. Excellent for showcasing product realism on the landing page.
Modern AC unit displaying 22 degrees. Use in the multi-step form when the customer selects the AC unit.
HVAC technician doing electrical/installation work. Great for the 'Our Technicians' section on the landing page or login screen background for the admin/tech portal.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where applicable (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.
Shadcn components must be used for complex UI (select, calendar, dialogs).
The application is Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia). Ensure all mock text and labels are in Indonesian.
Never use placeholders like via.placeholder.com. Use the exact image URLs provided in the design guidelines.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the precise color palette and fonts. 2. Import Manrope and IBM Plex Sans in index.html or index.css. 3. Ensure Shadcn components are installed as `.js` (JavaScript), not TypeScript, as the project uses JS.

implementation_phases.phase_1: Build the Marketing Landing page using the Tetris Grid layout and Crystal Glass sticky nav. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layout structure to maintain asymmetry.
implementation_phases.phase_2: Implement the multi-step public rental form. It must be mobile-friendly and utilize Shadcn's Form, Input, and Select elements. Do not forget to include Stripe payment integration UI.
implementation_phases.phase_3: Build the Admin Dashboard with a high-density, cardless, F-pattern layout. Prioritize clear tabular data for tracking operations.
implementation_phases.phase_4: Build the Field Technician Mobile Dashboard. Maximize scannability, use large touch targets for fat fingers, and prominent action buttons for status updates and photo uploads.
